exposure: adequate vs. inadequate initial nerve block height after spinal anesthesia
outcome: nerve block height after spinal anesthesia
cohort: 401 pregnant women undergoing cesarean delivery with spinal anesthesia
finding: Lower maternal BMI at delivery, in addition to less gestational age or underweight fetus, appears to be a factor associated with low initial block height after spinal anesthesia for cesarean delivery in a Japanese urban population.
